# Tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

97 tools in 13 toolsets. The local server registers all of them; the hosted
server registers 89 (the local-only tools are left out).
Which of them a connection sees also depends on its enabled toolsets, its policy and the integration of its
instance; see the README.

Columns: **Kind** is `read`, `write`, `destructive` (sends to other people, or replaces or removes
something) or `irreversible` (cannot be undone from this server). **Integrations** are the Evolution
integrations the tool works on: Baileys is `WHATSAPP-BAILEYS`, Business is `WHATSAPP-BUSINESS`, Evolution
is `EVOLUTION`.
**Local only** tools are not offered by the hosted server.

## instance

Connection status, QR pairing, restart, logout and online presence of the instance. 5 tools.

| Tool | Title | Kind | Integrations | Local only | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get_instance_status` | Get instance status | read | all | no | Report the connection state, integration and enabled toolsets of this Evolution instance. |
| `logout_instance` | Log out WhatsApp session | irreversible | Baileys | no | Unlink the WhatsApp session from this instance so that it stops receiving and sending messages. |
| `restart_instance` | Restart instance connection | destructive | Baileys | no | Restart the WhatsApp connection of this instance and return the connection state afterwards. |
| `set_presence` | Set online presence | write | Baileys | no | Show this WhatsApp number as online or offline to its contacts. |
| `start_pairing` | Start device pairing | write | Baileys | no | Start linking this WhatsApp Web instance to a phone and return a QR code or a pairing code. |

## messaging (default)

Send text, media, voice notes, locations, contact cards, polls, list and button messages; react, edit and delete sent messages. 15 tools.

| Tool | Title | Kind | Integrations | Local only | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delete_message_for_everyone` | Delete message for everyone | irreversible | Baileys | no | Delete a message this number sent from the chat for every participant (WhatsApp Web instances only). |
| `edit_message` | Edit sent message | destructive | Baileys | no | Replace the text of a message this number sent, or the caption of its image or video. |
| `react_to_message` | React to message | destructive | Baileys, Business | no | React to a message with an emoji, or remove the reaction with an empty emoji. |
| `send_button_message` | Send button message | destructive | all | no | Send a message with up to three buttons: quick replies, links, call buttons or copy-code buttons. |
| `send_chat_presence` | Show typing or recording | write | Baileys | no | Show a typing or recording indicator in a chat for a few seconds (WhatsApp Web instances only). |
| `send_contact_card` | Send contact card | destructive | Baileys, Business | no | Send one or more contact cards (name and phone number) to a person or group. |
| `send_list_message` | Send list message | destructive | Baileys, Business | no | Send a message with a button that opens a list of selectable rows. |
| `send_local_file` | Send local file | destructive | all | yes | Send a file from this computer to a person or group. |
| `send_location` | Send location | destructive | Baileys, Business | no | Send a map location pin with a name and address. |
| `send_media_message` | Send media from URL | destructive | all | no | Send an image, video, audio file or document that Evolution downloads from a public URL. |
| `send_poll` | Send poll | destructive | Baileys | no | Send a poll to a person or group (WhatsApp Web instances only). |
| `send_sticker` | Send sticker | destructive | Baileys | no | Send a sticker from a public image URL (WhatsApp Web instances only). |
| `send_text_message` | Send text message | destructive | all | no | Send a text message to a person or group from the connected number. |
| `send_video_note` | Send video note | destructive | Baileys | no | Send a video from a public URL as a round video note (WhatsApp Web instances only). |
| `send_voice_note` | Send voice note | destructive | all | no | Send an audio file from a public URL as a voice message. |

## chats (default)

List chats, read and search message history, delivery status, read/unread and archive state, received media. 11 tools.

| Tool | Title | Kind | Integrations | Local only | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `download_message_media` | Download message media | write | Baileys, Business | no | Save the attachment of a message (image, video, voice note, audio, document or sticker) as a file. |
| `get_chat` | Get chat details | read | all | no | Describe one chat: name, unread count, labels, whether the contact is saved and the latest message. |
| `get_message` | Get message | read | all | no | Return one stored message in full, including its raw Evolution message type. |
| `get_message_status` | Get message delivery status | read | all | no | Report how far a message got: sent, delivered, read or played. |
| `list_chats` | List chats | read | all | no | List chats with unread counts and a preview of the latest message, most recently active first. |
| `mark_chat_read` | Mark chat as read | destructive | Baileys | no | Mark received messages of a chat as read, so their senders see blue ticks. |
| `mark_chat_unread` | Mark chat as unread | write | Baileys | no | Mark a chat as unread on the linked phone, so it shows the unread dot again. |
| `read_messages` | Read chat messages | read | all | no | Read the stored message history of one chat, newest first, page by page. |
| `search_messages` | Search message text | read | all | no | Find messages whose text or caption contains a phrase, newest first, across chats or within one chat. |
| `set_chat_archived` | Archive or unarchive chat | write | Baileys | no | Archive a chat or move it back to the main chat list. |
| `view_message_image` | View image message | read | Baileys, Business | no | Show the image or sticker of a received or sent message as an image. |

## integrations

Evolution chatbots (Evolution Bot, Typebot, OpenAI, Dify, Flowise, n8n, EvoAI), their sessions, and Chatwoot. 17 tools.

| Tool | Title | Kind | Integrations | Local only | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `change_chatbot_session` | Change chatbot session | destructive | all | no | Resume, pause, close or delete the chatbot sessions of one chat for an integration. |
| `create_chatbot` | Create chatbot | destructive | all | yes | Create a chatbot that answers incoming WhatsApp messages through Evolution Bot, Typebot, OpenAI, Dify, etc. |
| `create_openai_credential` | Add OpenAI credential | write | all | yes | Store an OpenAI API key on this Evolution instance so that OpenAI chatbots can use it. |
| `delete_chatbot` | Delete chatbot | irreversible | all | no | Delete a chatbot together with all of its sessions; this cannot be undone from this server. |
| `delete_openai_credential` | Delete OpenAI credential | irreversible | all | no | Delete a stored OpenAI credential; the key cannot be recovered from this server. |
| `get_chatbot` | Get chatbot | read | all | no | Return the full configuration of one chatbot: trigger, behaviour, endpoint and provider-specific fields. |
| `get_chatbot_settings` | Get chatbot defaults | read | all | no | Return the session defaults shared by all chatbots of one integration. |
| `get_chatwoot_config` | Get Chatwoot integration | read | all | no | Return the Chatwoot integration settings of this instance: account, inbox, sync options and webhook URL. |
| `list_chatbot_sessions` | List chatbot sessions | read | all | no | List the conversations a chatbot is currently handling, optionally only those of one chat. |
| `list_chatbots` | List chatbots | read | all | no | List the chatbots configured on this Evolution instance, across all integrations or one. |
| `list_openai_credentials` | List OpenAI credentials | read | all | no | List the OpenAI credentials stored on this Evolution instance by name and id. |
| `list_openai_models` | List OpenAI models | read | all | no | List the OpenAI model ids that a stored credential can use, sorted alphabetically. |
| `set_chatbot_ignored_chat` | Ignore chat for chatbot | destructive | all | no | Add a chat to, or remove it from, the list of chats the chatbots of one integration skip. |
| `set_chatwoot_config` | Set Chatwoot integration | destructive | all | yes | Save the Chatwoot integration: connect this WhatsApp number to a Chatwoot account and inbox. |
| `start_typebot_session` | Start Typebot session | destructive | all | no | Start a Typebot flow in one chat, which sends that person the flow's first messages. |
| `update_chatbot` | Update chatbot | destructive | all | yes | Change fields of an existing chatbot; every field left out keeps its stored value, secrets included. |
| `update_chatbot_settings` | Update chatbot defaults | destructive | all | no | Change the session defaults shared by all chatbots of one integration; at least one value is required. |
